name: Borscht
description: Beetroot soup with cabbage and beef, soured and finished with a spoon of sour cream.

tcm.note: Root vegetables in a beef broth.

ayurveda.note: Beetroot is ushna and building; the soured stock adds more.

histamine.note: Beef broth, tomato and sour cream — and borscht is famously better on the second day.

nutrition.highlight: better on the second day, they say
